final: WITH s AS (SELECT si.zoneregistry AS z, si.insurstat AS st, AVG(m.facetresmm * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS r, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scanmesh m JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = m.zoneref WHERE si.insurstat IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(si.insurstat) <> '' GROUP BY si.zoneregistry, si.insurstat), a AS (SELECT st, AVG(r) AS av FROM s WHERE r IS NOT NULL GROUP BY st) SELECT s.st AS insurstat, AVG(s.r) AS avg_kept_ratio, COUNT(*) AS kept_sites, AVG(s.r - a.av) AS avg_excess FROM s JOIN a ON s.st = a.st WHERE s.r > a.av GROUP BY s.st
